name: Px Oatmilk Latte
caffeineNote: Decaffeinated base; the 60 mg the brand prints is paraxanthine (Px), not caffeine, and no caffeine figure is published
summary: Cold brew oatmilk latte built on decaffeinated coffee with 60 mg of paraxanthine added per 12 oz can — a caffeine metabolite the brand sells as steadier energy, not caffeine itself. Its caffeine column is blank for that reason rather than because we have not looked: the base is decaf and Rarebird publishes no residual figure, nor a nutrition panel.
